title: Supabase template gallery
description: A starter gallery: a two-line two-tone title (grey over ink) with an underlined link at its right, then two wide white cards (a small mark, a 14px title, two grey lines, and a little browser window with three dots running off the card's bottom) and a row of four compact cards with the text sitting low. Borders darken slightly on hover. Phones stack everything.
notes: descriptions are cut to two lines
the preview windows are media slots (pale placeholders when empty)
